value.rationale: The source identifies indefinitely fluctuating cycling beliefs in a motivated anti-confirmation regime, but does not determine whether cycles are truly periodic or aperiodic, how often beliefs exceed one-half, or their exact long-run distribution. The new theorem completes the natural one-dimensional classification, distinguishes neutral quasiperiodicity from chaotic expansion, gives a sharp finite-window discrepancy and a testable exact mean/high-belief frequency for the source’s nontrivial rational likelihoods. This is not a mere parameter substitution: the structural logit conjugacy and deterministic coding law supply substantive model-specific dynamics. Does not claim a new theorem in classical Sturmian or rotation theory.
